inlines.text: 이 페이지는 명령·권한·동의·예약 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

소비자 계약(authority-and-reservation-no-roll): replacement availableAfter=availableBefore+oldUnconsumedReservation-newReservation>=0; consumed/completed unchanged. Actual delivery, valid grant and separate acceptance required; no queue.

blocks.text:
authority [bounded-symbolic-contract] issuer==sender && grantee==recipient && scope==order.scope && channel==order.channel && start<=now && now<end && !effectiveRevoked
reserve [bounded-symbolic-contract] newStock=stock+oldReserved-requested; newReserved=requested
release [bounded-symbolic-contract] newStock=stock+reserved; newReserved=0; completed'=completed; consumed'=consumed
battle-receipt [bounded-symbolic-contract] receivedAt=now
reaction-reference [reference-only-not-adopted-consent] reaction=sum(three explicit d6)+modifier; bands <=0,1..3,4..6,7..9,10..12,13..15,16..18,>=19
D03-F1 [후보·승인 전] authorized=exactGrantMatch && start<=now && now<end && !revoked; execute requires actualReceived && accepted && feasible
D03-F2 [후보·승인 전] acceptedReplacement: stockAfter=stock+oldReserved-requested>=0; reservedAfter=requested; release: stockAfter=stock+oldReserved,reservedAfter=0; consumed/completed unchanged

inlines.text: D03의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

items.text: IDs — nonempty stable order/proposal/event/result/sender/recipient/scope/resource IDs; no alias or renumber (stable identifier)
actor — alive/capable/safe/detained/scheduleConflict booleans; supplied D01/D02 facts, not verified world authority (predicate or record; see description)
grant — issuer=sender, grantee=recipient, exact scope/channel, finite start/end, effective revoked boolean or null unresolved external event order (predicate or record; see description)
delivery — strategic actual physical receipt plus route; battle registered matching sender/recipient/scope assignment and same-time signal (predicate or record; see description)
consent — accept|hold|refuse|negotiate|unknown; explicit recipient choice, never inferred from reaction, role or Leadership (predicate or record; see description)
time — finite world-clock-coordinate, same unit on now/start/end/receipt; no fixed rate, duration or seconds conversion (same world-clock-coordinate)
resources — safe nonnegative integers with unit 1 in same resourceId; verification tokens only, not approved gameplay prices (same-resource verification token)
null — unknown; no zero, false, consent or authority substitution (predicate or record; see description)

inlines.text: 자료 소유자는 D03 command records; no world authority issuer implemented, 유지 계약은 authority·reserve·release·battle-receipt다. 상태 소유 경계는 grant,actual delivery,order acceptance,current intent,unconsumed reservations,consent,revocation and receipts. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

items.text: 후보 오류: E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSENT, E_EXTERNAL_ORDER, E_CONSERVATION
기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_VERSION, E_CHECKPOINT, E_ID, E_RANGE, E_UNIT, E_ENUM, E_REFERENCE, E_REVISION, E_RESULT_CONFLICT

어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

inlines.text: 제거 대상 차용 산식: reaction-reference. Remove call/dependency from original operative consumer, not original records/historical references/tests.

items.text: caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

inlines.text: 현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D03-authorized-order-reservation(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/authorized-order-reservation.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/authorized-order-reservation.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.
